caveat: Pikalytics lags the live season; cross-check ladder usage against data/meta/usage_pokemon.json (pokebase).
format_notes: Pokemon Champions VGC 2026 Tournaments is currently led by Rillaboom at 48.87% usage. The top of the usage chart also includes Rillaboom, Sneasler, Salamence-Mega, Incineroar, and Kingambit.
The most common two-Pokemon core is Rillaboom, and Sneasler, appearing on 398 teams (25.8% of the sampled field).
The top three-Pokemon core is Rillaboom, Salamence-Mega, and Sneasler, which highlights one of the most repeated structures in the format.
The current featured top team is from DDee at 12-0.
